programmes.d: Newly's skill with both people and medicine is put to the test when Doc sends him out to check on families in the back country
A young fanner's ex-partner in crime, his girlfriend, and his slow-witted brother figure in the discovery of his forgotten past.
When a young outlaw becomes the victim of his own gang, he decides to help Marshal Matt Dillon bring them in.
A young girl falls in love with Doc Adams after he rescues her from her brutal family.
A young girl confesses to killing her father because he refused to let her marry a handsome farmhand.
Anthony Zerbe plays Talbot, an outlaw who falls in love with the widow of a man he has been forced to kill in self-defense.
A preacher disgusted by violence is harassed by bully Sam Keeler who despises his timid nature.
A former gunslinger is goaded into a duel by his fiancee's brother.
A would-be bounty hunter has a hidden motive in persuading Marshal Matt Dillon to help him bring in a wanted man.
Doc must find a way to thwart a typhoid epidemic in Dodge.
A man who claims he's innocent of a murder in a corrupt town breaks out of Matt's jail, and his trail leads Matt to the corrupt sheriff (Mort Mills appears).
Bank robbers bushwhack Chester on their way to Dodge.
When a young woman begins a romance with a drifter, her brothers plot his death so they will not lose her as a household servant.
Doc has a change of heart about a man he hates and wants to kill face to face when the man is later shot in the back.
Although Kitty has prevented two men from molesting Chavela Ramirez, the girl's father wants revenge.
A badly wounded trail hand scorns Marshal Dillon's help and sets out on his own to get the man who wounded him.
Twin brothers run their crippled father's fuel and feed store until one of them is killed by an unknown assailant.
Kitty needs all of her courage in facing death as she takes an expectant mother on a perilous stagecoach journey.
A drifting cowboy steals an elderly rancher's youthful wife and then brutally informs her their romance is over
A young man is caught in the web of a trumped-up rustling charge, jailbreak, and murder.
Matt must defend a gunman he despises from townspeople who want to lynch him for a crime he didn't commit.
Doc has gone missing and it is up to Chester to find him.
A beautiful Mexican girl sacrifices her freedom to save Chester's life. (TV-PG)
The mother of two infamous outlaw sons, against great odds, tries to steer her youngest boy into an honest life.
